Tempered Glass Side Panel
Featuring a high-clarity tempered glass panel, it provides a clear view of the internal components, allowing you to showcase your hardware configuration and vibrant lighting effects.
Optimized Airflow Design
Designed with multiple air intake and exhaust openings to improve airflow and reduce system temperatures. Optimized airflow paths promote efficient heat dissipation, ensuring every component receives sufficient cool air for stable performance.
Tool-Free Quick-Release Design
Featuring a convenient snap-lock mechanism, the tool-free design allows easy access to the case interior without screws or additional tools, making component installation, upgrades, and maintenance quick and effortless.
Comprehensive Dust Protection Design
Designed with strategically placed dust filters and protective sealing, the case effectively prevents dust, lint, and other fine particles from entering the interior. This helps maintain a clean internal environment and consistent airflow, reducing dust buildup on cooling components to preserve cooling efficiency and simplify routine maintenance.
Convenient Front I/O Design
Featuring an easily accessible front I/O panel with multiple connectivity options, including USB ports and audio jacks, allowing you to conveniently connect a wide range of external devices and peripherals.
